description: You are a Quality Assurance Engineer at Precision Components Inc. Production has been halted since yesterday because all quality alerts currently in the 'In Progress' stage are missing CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) documentation, which is required before the batch release decision can be made. Your QA manager requires all open In Progress quality alerts to have both a corrective action (what was done to fix the immediate issue) and a preventive action (what process change prevents recurrence) documented, and then each alert must be transitioned to the Done stage to formally close them. Log in to the quality management system at http://localhost:8069 with username admin and password admin. Complete CAPA closure for every quality alert currently in the In Progress stage.
